title: Exact module-sheaf evaluation at a weakly contractible pro-etale object
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a sheaf of commutative rings and W an object of its pro-etale site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume evaluation at W makes every epimorphism of Type (u+1)-valued sheaves surjective. Then evaluation at W from sheaves of R-modules to modules over R(W) preserves homology.

source.place: Tag 0946 (1), module kernels and cokernels Tag 03DA; epi criteria Tags 03CN and 00WN

proof.text: Forget a module epimorphism to abelian sheaves; the forgetful functor preserves cokernels. The abelian-sheaf epi criterion gives local surjectivity, and forgetting further to set sheaves makes the same map epic. Apply the given weak contractibility to obtain surjectivity of module evaluation. Kernels are already computed sectionwise. Mathlib Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels finishes.

theorem weaklyContractible_evaluation_preservesHomology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (W : X.ProEt)
    (hW : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op W))) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R) (op W)).PreservesHomology
